title: The native-network gate audit
claim: Let a law compose like cycles, and let K1 on X + {e} and K2 on Y + {e} be knots of its systems sharing exactly the distinction e, with the same range for e in both. Then (a) each is a complete contact (K1-K3); (b) forgetting e turns the pair into a single knot on X + Y, and with e kept the pair has exactly the circuits X + {e}, Y + {e} and X + Y; (c) so nothing is lost, no two distinctions are tied, and the pair is not a common hub; (d) the composite is the projection of the allowed states, independent of presentation and of any external rule; (e) recodings carry it; (f) elimination persists under erasure and restriction by the law's own relations, and under pinning exactly when the law with constants still composes like cycles, which affine laws over finite fields do (with polynomial-time constraint problems) and parity beside J and K4 do not; (g) isomorphisms and pp-definitions preserve every gate, while homomorphic equivalence (the equal-top lift of K3 and K3) and products (Z2 and Z3 against Z6) do not. Hence such a pair passes the contact-network gate of docs/COMMON_VERBIAGE.md under recodings, erasures, restriction by the law's relations, isomorphisms and pp-definitions; the 3-net law of S3 shows that passing pairs do not certify a law, and not-all-three pairs are hubs.
failure_conditions: A pair of knots of a census law composing like cycles whose composite is not one knot on all other distinctions, which has a tie or which is a hub, in some placement or after relabelling.
A sampled system of a census law, or of an affine law with constants, that violates elimination.
The pinned parity-beside-J or K4 system, the K3 system or the Z6 system satisfies elimination.
The S3 doubled Thomsen system satisfies elimination, or a not-all-three pair is not a hub.
foundation_claim_scope: The contact-network gate of docs/COMMON_VERBIAGE.md for pairs of knots in laws that compose like cycles. No native recurrence beyond the K1-K3 reading, no path, separation or distance (ticket B), no metric distance, and no physical claim.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py tests 99 pairs of the eleven census laws (and their relabellings), 660 sampled systems of those laws, 240 sampled pinned systems of three affine laws, the pinned failures of parity beside J and K4, a pp-expansion of parity, the lift of K3 against K3, Z6, S3 and not-all-three; six controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with explicit and randomized checks; the top lemma, the Latin and affine structure of tops, the utility, tractability and loop-homology proofs and matroid circuit elimination are cited; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta: elementary given the composition series; new to the program is the gate-by-gate reading, the first pair of contacts to pass the contact-network gate under the canonical knot test, the dependence of the verdict on admitted pinning and transports, and the S3 warning that pairs do not certify a law.
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-21.
